archiveSurvey.selection: All sensor C CLEAR multi-detector images, without thinning. Other filters and earlier single-detector observations are counted, not claimed as inspected rasters.
archiveSurvey.limitation: Archive completeness and detector sampling do not establish nucleus coverage or the attitude of the Stooke shape.

shape.description: Stooke shape, east-positive longitude and long-axis +Z toward the large end; Vega 2 02:00:30 reference longitude 270 degrees.

dataset.credit: Keller, H. U., N. Thomas, W. Curdt, and G. Schwarz; Giotto HMC; International Halley Watch; NASA PDS.

missingEvidence: Source-controlled mapping from Stooke body coordinates to the encounter camera.
Validated surface coverage excluding foreground dust and unresolved limb/terminator pixels.
Registration residuals and validation in an independent frame.
result.meaning: Raster decoding is verified. Surface registration has not been established or attempted with a guessed attitude.

distribution.originalGuideStatement: MPS retains image copyright; scientific study allowed; publication and non-scientific use require written permission.
distribution.disposition: The repository retains retrieval pins and diagnostic code. Downloaded frames and image derivatives remain local, outside application assets.
